titulo: The Lizard Man Left Three Scratches on My Car Roof 🦎 #Shorts
titulo_pt: O Homem-Lagarto deixou três arranhões no teto do meu carro
resumo_pt: Um adolescente para com pneu furado perto do pântano Scape Ore e o Homem-Lagarto (verde, olhos vermelhos, três dedos) pula no teto do carro. De manhã ele mostra os arranhões ao xerife, que ri e diz que o monstro não existe. A luva que o xerife usa há 30 anos escorrega: a mão dele tem três dedos verdes. O xerife era o Homem-Lagarto, por isso as buscas nunca o encontravam.
descricao:
The sheriff led every search party for thirty years. They never found a thing.

Would you have told the sheriff?

Follow @VeilFrequency for a new horror story every day. Fictional story based on American folklore. Images are AI-generated.
personagens: the narrator is a skinny seventeen-year-old boy with messy black hair in a red fast-food uniform and cap, driving an old blue sedan; the sheriff is a heavy man in his sixties with a gray mustache, a tan uniform, a cowboy hat and one black leather glove on his left hand; the Lizard Man is seven feet tall, muscular, covered in wet green scales, with glowing red eyes and three long clawed fingers on each hand

scenes.text: Never stop near Scape Ore Swamp after midnight.
scenes.pt: Nunca pare perto do pântano Scape Ore depois da meia-noite.
scenes.visual: a lonely road beside a dark South Carolina swamp at night, mist over the water, an old blue sedan with its hazard lights on

scenes.text: I did. And seven feet of green scales stepped out.
scenes.pt: Eu parei. E dois metros de escamas verdes saíram de lá.
scenes.visual: the Lizard Man stepping out of the swamp onto the road, red eyes glowing in the car's headlights

scenes.text: Red eyes. Three fingers on each hand.
scenes.pt: Olhos vermelhos. Três dedos em cada mão.
scenes.visual: close up of the Lizard Man's scaly three-fingered hand with long claws, red eyes behind it

scenes.text: I'd only stopped to change a flat.
scenes.pt: Eu só tinha parado para trocar um pneu furado.
scenes.visual: the narrator alone kneeling by a flat tire with a jack, looking up in terror

scenes.text: I dropped the jack and ran for my door.
scenes.pt: Larguei o macaco e corri para a porta.
scenes.visual: the narrator alone diving into the driver's seat of the blue sedan

scenes.pt: Ele pulou no teto do carro.
scenes.visual: the Lizard Man crouched on the roof of the blue sedan at night

scenes.text: Claws scraped the metal above my head.
scenes.pt: As garras rasparam o metal em cima da minha cabeça.
scenes.visual: the narrator alone inside the car looking up in horror, three claw tips piercing through the roof lining

scenes.text: I floored it. It held on for a mile.
scenes.pt: Pisei fundo. Ele se segurou por um quilômetro e meio.
scenes.visual: the blue sedan speeding down a dark road with the Lizard Man clinging to the roof

scenes.text: Then it rolled off into the swamp.
scenes.pt: Aí ele rolou para dentro do pântano.
scenes.visual: the Lizard Man tumbling off the car into black swamp water

scenes.text: Next morning, I showed the sheriff my roof.
scenes.pt: Na manhã seguinte, mostrei o teto do carro ao xerife.
scenes.visual: the narrator and the sheriff standing beside the blue sedan in daylight, looking at the roof
three long claw scratches across the sedan's blue roof in morning sun
the sheriff laughing, thumbs in his belt, his black glove on his left hand

scenes.text: He'd worn that glove for thirty years.
scenes.pt: Ele usava aquela luva há trinta anos.
scenes.visual: close up of the sheriff's black leather glove resting on the car roof

scenes.text: He traced the scratches. The glove slipped off.
scenes.pt: Ele passou a mão nos arranhões. A luva escorregou.
scenes.visual: the sheriff's glove sliding off his hand onto the car roof

scenes.text: Three green fingers. Covered in scales.
scenes.pt: Três dedos verdes. Cobertos de escamas.
scenes.visual: the sheriff's bare left hand: three long green scaly fingers lined up perfectly with the scratches, the narrator staring in shock

scenes.text: No search party ever found the Lizard Man.
scenes.pt: Nenhuma equipe de busca jamais achou o Homem-Lagarto.
scenes.visual: the sheriff smiling under his cowboy hat, his eyes glinting red

scenes.text: Because the sheriff led every one.
scenes.pt: Porque era o xerife que liderava todas.
scenes.visual: an old photo on a station wall: the sheriff leading a search party into the swamp, a gloved hand raised
